title: He was so easily at the mercy of childish and unworthy imperfections
html_source: Stephen is surprised at the fact that he is still human and subject to temptation and moral error.

 He had no temptations to sin mortally. It surprised him however to find that at the end of his course of intricate piety and selfrestraint
